card.name: AC ending of CARDIAC in warnings
card.fires_on: The final piece "AC" (or "iac") completing the word CARDIAC, mostly in capitalised boxed-warning headings such as CARDIAC TOXICITY or CARDIAC ARREST.

modes.label: Capitalised warning headings
modes.description: "AC" finishes CARDIAC in an all-caps boxed warning title.

modes.label: Cardiac in running text
modes.description: "AC" or "iac" finishes cardiac in an all-caps phrase or trial name within warning text.
